Callum Reid  
📞 +91 98765 43210 | 📧 callum.reid@example.com | 📍 Mumbai, India | 🌐 linkedin.com/in/callumreid | 📄 github.com/callumreid  

As a frontend engineer at NovaGame Studios, I’ve focused on building scalable, accessible, and performance-optimized web experiences for gaming platforms. My work emphasizes collaboration with cross-functional teams to deliver user-centric solutions that align with business goals. Over the past five years, I’ve transitioned from junior to senior roles, driving technical leadership in complex projects while maintaining a strong emphasis on test-driven development and code quality.  

At NovaGame Studios (2022–present), I lead frontend architecture for flagship game portals, ensuring seamless integration of UI components across multiple platforms. My work includes implementing GraphQL-based data fetching for dynamic content loading, reducing API latency by 30% through optimized query batching. I’ve also spearheaded the migration of legacy UI components to TypeScript, improving maintainability and reducing bug rates by 25%. A recent project involved redesigning a player dashboard using Next.js, which increased user engagement metrics by 18% within three months.  

Prior to that, at PixelPulse Interactive (2020–2022), I developed reusable UI libraries for internal tools, which saved 20+ hours of manual coding across teams. I contributed to a REST API redesign for a multiplayer game backend, streamlining data flow between frontend and backend systems. My approach to state management with Redux improved scalability in high-traffic scenarios, supporting concurrent users during peak events.  

In my early career at LunaGame Studios (2018–2020), I built interactive web interfaces for game demos, focusing on responsive design principles to ensure cross-device compatibility. I also introduced unit testing frameworks to legacy codebases, reducing regression risks and improving code reliability.  

**Technical Skills / Technologies**  
React: Engineered reusable components for game portals, optimized rendering for real-time updates, and led the transition to TypeScript in large-scale projects.  
Next.js: Built high-performance static sites for game showcases, leveraging server-side rendering to improve SEO and load times.  
TypeScript: Implemented type-safe architecture for internal tools, reducing runtime errors and enhancing team productivity.  
GraphQL: Integrated with backend systems to fetch dynamic content, reducing redundant API calls and improving data consistency.  
REST API design: Redesigned endpoints for a multiplayer game, ensuring scalable and secure communication between frontend and backend.  
State management (Redux/Zustand): Developed centralized state patterns for complex UI interactions, enabling smoother user experiences.  
Test automation: Automated end-to-end tests for critical game features, ensuring reliability across browser and device combinations.  
Unit testing: Established testing frameworks for core components, reducing critical bugs by 40% in production environments.  
Web accessibility (WCAG): Audited and remediated UI components to meet AA standards, ensuring inclusive access for all users.  
JavaScript: Owned core frontend logic for multiple projects, balancing performance and usability in high-traffic scenarios.  
Responsive design: Designed adaptive layouts for game dashboards, ensuring seamless user experiences across desktop and mobile.  

**Languages**  
English (native), Hindi (fluent)  

**Projects / Side Projects**  
- **Game Analytics Dashboard (React/TypeScript)**: Built a real-time analytics tool for developers, integrating GraphQL to fetch live data and visualize player behavior.  
- **Static Game Portfolio (Next.js)**: Created a portfolio site for indie developers, using Next.js for SEO optimization and fast load times.  
- **Accessibility Audit Tool (React)**: Developed a tool to scan web pages for WCAG compliance, highlighting issues like contrast ratios and focusable elements.
